subject: Cloud cost governance RFP / vendor coordination
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Cloud cost governance RFP - kickoff

Hi all,

I attached the first-draft RFP for the cloud cost governance tooling we discussed in last week's leadership sync (CostGovernance_RFP_v1.pdf). Goal is to run a short vendor evaluation + POC in Q2 and choose a partner for a pilot on our Hosted and Dedicated deployments.

Asks:
- Please review the RFP and add must-have vs nice-to-have rows in the "Evaluation" tab by EOD Mon (Mar 1).
- Nominate one SME for security/compliance, one for runtime/instrumentation, and one procurement lead.
- Quick note on budget range: I'm estimating $120K–180K ARR for pilot+first-year support; we can refine.

High-level evaluation criteria I want covered:
- Cost allocation & tagging auto-ingest
- Real-time per-request attribution (kv cache-aware)
- Integration with our runtime metrics and token accounting
- Quantization-aware cost modeling
- Data residency controls (GDPR, EU/US zoning where applicable)

I'll compile and send to a short list of 3 vendors next week.

Thanks,
Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Head of Platform Partnerships, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2026 11:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cloud cost governance RFP - kickoff

Jordan — thanks for pulling this together. Quick notes after a skim:

- Procurement: I can be the procurement lead for vendor commercials and contracting. I'll need an expected PO cadence and whether Finance wants a multi-year commitment or pilot-first approach.
- Timeline: vendor shortlist + NDA week of Mar 8, demos Mar 15–19, POC in April. If we accept pilot pricing, we'll need budget sign-off by Apr 10.
- Please add a section for required SLAs and our minimum uptime/latency expectations for dedicated pools.

I'm attaching a procurement checklist that outlines vendor verification steps and required docs (procurement_checklist.pdf).

Laura
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Mar 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cloud cost governance RFP - technical criteria

On Sun, Feb 28, 2026 at 11:06, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Jordan — thanks for pulling this together. Quick notes after a skim...

Fwd-ing my technical bullets below (attached usage_report_q1.csv for baseline consumption):

- We need per-route token-level cost breakdowns and the ability to attribute costs to model variants, quantization profiles, and request prefixes.
- Integration: must ingest metrics from our runtime metrics API and from Prometheus. Prefer minimal sidecar footprint.
- KV/prefix caching: vendor must understand caching impact on cost modeling; naive per-token attribution will overcount.
- Sampling + anomaly detection: ability to flag sudden unit-cost regressions by route/model.
- Export formats: parquet for long-term storage, streaming to our observability pipeline is required.

I'll be the SME for the runtime side.

Marcus
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference

From: Anna Kline <anna@chargelens.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@chargelens.com
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 10:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cloud cost governance RFP - ChargeLens response

Hi Jordan — thanks for the RFP and the opportunity.

ChargeLens is available for a 60-minute demo on Tue, Mar 9 (we can do 09:00 or 14:00 PT). We have a short SOW draft attached (ChargeLens_SOW_vDraft.docx) outlining a 6-week POC that covers realtime attribution + Prometheus ingestion + a small sample export into your data lake.

Preliminary notes:
- We can integrate with your runtime metrics API and provide a per-request attribution hook.
- We will need a low-overhead collector; we recommend a light agent and a streaming export.
- Data residency: for the pilot we can host in US regions; we have EU plans for production if needed.

If you can share a timeslot, we will send a calendar invite and a demo agenda.

Warmly,
Anna Kline
Head of Solutions, ChargeLens
anna@chargelens.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Anna Kline <anna@chargelens.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cloud cost governance RFP - next steps & docs

Thanks Anna — Mar 9 at 14:00 PT works for the team. Calendar invite should be fine.

Internal note to the group:
- I've added a Drive doc (linked below) for feature scoring. Please add numerical scores (1–5) for must-have rows by Mar 8 EOD.
- Priority SMEs: Marcus (runtime), Grace (security/compliance), Laura (procurement).
- Related links: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2B3cCostGovernance-RFP, HubSpot:HS-473209, JIRA FINOPS-142.

Immediate asks:
1) Marcus — add the top 3 telemetry fields you need in the scoring doc so vendors can confirm ingestion compatibility.
2) Grace — please paste any hard redlines re: data retention/GDPR.
3) Laura — begin scoping commercial terms (pilot pricing vs subscription).

I'll consolidate post-demo and push for a POC agreement if ChargeLens looks good.

Jordan

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2026 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cloud cost governance RFP - approval to proceed to POC

Jordan / team — after reviewing the RFP and the proposed SOW draft from ChargeLens I approve moving forward to a paid POC under the following conditions:

- POC must be limited to non-prod environments and US-only data for now.
- Minimal data retention during POC (30 days) and clear rules for export/deletion.
- Security review: Rishi, please confirm whether we need a quick pen test or if the vendor's SOC2 Type II is sufficient for the pilot.
- Procurement: Laura, please start the PO draft and include a 60-day termination clause for the pilot.

If procurement/legal sign-off looks good, proceed to schedule the POC kickoff within one week of demo acceptance.

Thanks — Grace
VP, Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
